description: Plan a speaker checkerboard (each speaker's turns on their own video/audio track) from a caller-supplied word timeline. Returns frame-snapped segments, split points, track assignments, and the add_track/razor_all_tracks/move_clip_to_track routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

base_audio_track_index.description: Audio track holding the source clip; defaults to 0.

base_video_track_index.description: Video track holding the source clip; defaults to 0.

frame_rate.description: Sequence frame rate used to snap times to frames; defaults to 30.

handle_frames.description: Frames to pad each segment outward, clamped so adjacent turns never overlap; defaults to 2.

merge_gap_seconds.description: Same-speaker words separated by at most this gap merge into one turn; defaults to 0.5.

min_turn_seconds.description: Interior turns shorter than this are absorbed into the surrounding speaker; defaults to 0.8.

speaker_order.description: Optional speaker labels fixing track slot order; unlisted speakers append in first-appearance order.

items.description: Speaker label exactly as used in word_timeline.

track_per_speaker.description: true (default) assigns one track per speaker; false alternates consecutive segments between two tracks.

word_timeline.description: Caller-supplied word-timed transcript for one Premiere source item. Words must be ordered by start time and bound to the transcript revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp. Different labeled speakers may overlap; same-speaker words may not, even when another speaker is between them.

words.description: Ordered word tokens with source-time boundaries.

name: plan_speaker_checkerboard

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Plan Speaker Checkerboard
